rules.historical_missingness: Zero filling is confined to historical reproduction.
rules.analysis_missingness: No imputation or renormalisation; four hazard and five exposure dimensions are required for complete priority.
rules.interpretation: Priority tiers are screening categories, not evidence of safety or measured risk.
rules.provenance: Use existing eligible component scores and source decisions without reselection.

historical_source.scope: Complete PBMT column contract and six available historical exposure indicators; compatibility fallback for missing columns is not used.
